plainText:
The Navel Gym (Japanese: ネーブルジム Navel Gym) is the official Gym of Navel Island. The Gym Leader is Danny. s who meet his challenges receive the .

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
The Navel Gym made its only appearance in the Pokémon the Series: The Beginning episode Navel Maneuvers.

The Navel Gym isn't a building and instead spans the entire mountain on Navel Island. Unlike most Gyms, there is no battling involved at this Gym. Instead, Danny makes Trainers participate in several mountaineering challenges, including scaling the mountain without the aid of any as an entrance test before the actual rounds begin, lest they be disqualified. 

To win the coveted Sea Ruby Badge, a challenger must win in two of three of the following speed tests. In the first round, a challenger must freeze a natural geyser the fastest. Next, the ice made from freezing the geyser water must be crafted into bobsleds, with each side using three Pokémon to accomplish this in another test of speed. Finally, in the third round, the Gym Leader and challenger race down the mountain in their newly-constructed bobsleds with the aid of three Pokémon each for avoiding obstacles and enhancing speed.

===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
The Navel Gym made a brief cameo appearance in You Bet Your Wife, where was seen exiting the Gym, having just won himself his third Orange League Gym Badge.
 

==Trivia==
Navel Gym is the only known Gym without a battlefield.
